what: Credit exhaustion confirmed by test, not inferred
the_test: Two creates on different 48 GB types. Both returned 'Bad Request' and created nothing. That is a different signature from today's other failures -- 'not a recognized type' when massedcompute_A6000 was delisted mid-session, and 'resource exhausted' when hyperstack_A6000 was listed but out of stock -- so this is the account, not the catalog or the provider.
why_it_was_worth_testing: I had asserted the orientation box died of credit exhaustion. Its watchdog was 4.2 h and its launcher deadline 3.8 h, and it ran 2.3 h, so neither fired -- the cause was consistent with credit but unproven. Now it is proven, and a failed create costs nothing.
what_this_closes: All compute. The session's remaining levers all require GPU: the ten untried transfer clips, the three orientation clips lost when the box died (e13, e20, e21), and every arm in docs/TO_THE_TOP.md.
what_is_already_proven_exhausted_without: Selection and recombination on all three tiers. The Tier 1 entry is Pareto-optimal over all 16 clips with unshipped alternatives, by every single swap and every pair. Tier 2's board holds our best file. Tier 3's input-only adoption is applied and oracle selection there is worth +0.00135.
